LakeOfRageLanceForcedToEvolveText:
This lake is full
of GYARADOS but nothing else…

So the MAGIKARP
are being forced to evolve…
LakeOfRageLanceIntroText:
Did you come here
because of the rumors?

You're {PLAYER}?
I'm LANCE, a trainer like you.

I heard some ru-
mors, so I came to investigate…

I saw the way you
battled earlier, .

I can tell that
you're a trainer

with considerable
skill.

If you don't mind,
could you help me investigate?
LakeOfRageLanceRadioSignalText:
LANCE: Excellent!

It seems that the
LAKE's MAGIKARP

are being forced
to evolve.

A mysterious radio
broadcast coming

from MAHOGANY is
the cause.

I'll be waiting
for you, .
LakeOfRageLanceRefusedText:
Oh… Well, if you
change your mind, please help me.
LakeOfRageLanceAskHelpText:
LANCE: Hm? Are you
going to help me?
LakeOfRageGrampsText:
The GYARADOS are
angry!

It's a bad omen!
LakeOfRageGrampsText_ClearedRocketHideou:
Hahah! The MAGI-
KARP are biting!
LakeOfRageSuperNerdText:
I heard this lake
was made by ram- paging GYARADOS.

I wonder if there
is any connection

to their mass out-
break now?
LakeOfRageCooltrainerFText:
Did my eyes de-
ceive me? I saw a

red GYARADOS in
the LAKE…

But I thought
GYARADOS were usually blue?
FisherAndreSeenText:
Let me battle with
the #MON I just caught!
FisherAndreBeatenText:
I might be an ex-
pert angler, but

I stink as a #-
MON trainer…
FisherAndreAfterBattleText:
I won't lose as an
angler! I catch #MON all day.
FisherRaymondSeenText:
No matter what I
do, all I catch

are the same #-
MON…
FisherRaymondAfterBattleText:
Why can't I catch
any good #MON?
CooltrainermAaronSeenText:
If a trainer spots
another trainer,

he has to make a
challenge.

That is our
destiny.
CooltrainermAaronAfterBattleText:
#MON and their
trainer become

powerful through
constant battling.
CooltrainerfLoisSeenText:
What happened to
the red GYARADOS?

It's gone?

Oh, darn. I came
here for nothing?

I know--let's
battle!
CooltrainerfLoisAfterBattleText:
Come to think of
it, I've seen a pink BUTTERFREE.
MeetWesleyText:
WESLEY: Well, how
do you do?

Seeing as how it's
Wednesday today,

I'm WESLEY of
Wednesday.
WesleyGivesGiftText:
Pleased to meet
you. Please take a souvenir.
WesleyGaveGiftText:
WESLEY: BLACKBELT
beefs up the power of fighting moves.
WesleyWednesdayText:
WESLEY: Since you
found me, you must

have met my broth-
ers and sisters.

Or did you just
get lucky?
WesleyNotWednesdayText:
WESLEY: Today's
not Wednesday. That's too bad.
LakeOfRageSignText:
LAKE OF RAGE,
also known as GYARADOS LAKE.
